##### Project general facts

Binghatti Skyrise by Binghatti is a landmark residential development of three high-rise towers with a crystal-like facade that catches the light like a rare gemstone. Crafted with exceptional attention to detail, the towers rise above basement and podium parking levels to more than forty residential floors, creating an iconic presence on the skyline. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed for refined everyday comfort.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool with city views, a children's pool and aquatic area, indoor and outdoor gyms, a sauna, a steam room, a shared jacuzzi and a treatment room. A private golf course with a lake, padel, tennis, badminton and basketball courts, a skate park and a jogging track add variety, while an amphitheatre, a multipurpose pavilion, landscaped gardens and sunken seating create social spaces, supported by covered parking and round-the-clock security.

Interiors are thoughtfully designed to create airy spaces where luxury blends with everyday life, with large windows framing views of the skyline and the canal. Efficient layouts suit professionals and investors seeking a central address. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is a dynamic central district along the Dubai Water Canal, combining office towers, hotels, residential buildings and waterfront promenades. Restaurants, cafes, gyms and supermarkets line the canal and the streets around Bay Avenue, creating a vibrant urban atmosphere within walking distance of Downtown Dubai and its landmark attractions.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and Financial Centre Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Business Bay metro station is close by. The Dubai Water Canal is a short walk away, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and Dubai Opera are close by, and the Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai Design District, Coca-Cola Arena and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Business Bay is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most liquid residential markets in Dubai. Proximity to Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy and strong rental demand. Compact studios and one-bedroom apartments with extensive amenities underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
